prompt:
Our fintech compliance team already uses the auto-generated index system for ADRs and pitfalls in this repo. We now have three new RFC (Request for Comments) files sitting in `doc/rfc/` that track important API governance decisions — but there's no catalog for them yet. There's a stale hand-maintained tracker in that folder but it's already out of date and missing fields.

We need the same automated index system wired up for RFCs. Each RFC has a proposer (the engineer who submitted it), and we want that visible in the catalog alongside the title, status, and date.

Please set up the RFC index infrastructure so that running the existing generator script with an `rfc` argument produces a fully populated, auto-generated index table in `doc/rfc/README.md`. The README should have some introductory context before the table. The existing ADR and pitfall generator behavior must continue to work.
